narrative.details:
I've checked our inventory and all of the selections Mr. Lewells has listed are currently available.

You will, however, need to procure them off the shelves yourself. Part of our librarian duty is vigilance, and for that, I will resume supervisory bookkeeping.

Returning with the material to Roy on his behalf will not mark yourself accountable for their return; as with his note you're serving as the book club's official courier. Their establishment shall carry that burden.

Good day, adventurer.
narrative.objectives: Find each of the reading materials located somewhere in the library and then return to Roy Lewells in Stormwind's Park.
narrative.offerRewardText: These are them! Some of them even smell exotic! Fantastic, I can't wait for us to have lively conversations about these writings.Cellar after hours, of course.Thanks for the quick errand run, Gad. As promised, it's on the house. We keep our word here.
narrative.requestItemsText: You forgot what you had to do the moment you stepped through the door, eh? Happens to everyone.
